title: How Interactive CTV Ads Are Transforming Streaming TV

facts.fact: The page states that the article is a 4 minute read.
Interactive CTV advertising is defined on the page as connected TV ad formats that let viewers engage directly with ad messages on a TV screen.
facts.quote: Interactive CTV advertising refers to connected TV ad formats that allow viewers to engage directly with ad messages appearing on a TV screen.

facts.fact: The page lists QR codes, shoppable ads, social integration, navigation menus, gamified ads, surveys and feedback, and clickable formats as types of interactive CTV ads.
The page says shoppable ads let viewers browse or purchase products directly from streaming TV experiences.
facts.quote: Shoppable ads allow viewers to browse or purchase products directly from streaming TV experiences.

facts.fact: The page says viewers can scan a QR code shown on a TV screen with a phone and continue the experience there without interrupting streaming content.
facts.quote: Viewers can quickly scan codes from a TV screen and continue the experience on their phones without interrupting streaming content.

facts.fact: The page describes pause ad formats as interactive ad messages that display when viewers pause streaming content.
facts.quote: Pause ad formats display interactive ad messages when viewers pause streaming content.
